ActorTalk: I got held up by people from the 【kuroname】 Society.
When they found out the Gray Raven Commandant was here, they were all beside themselves with joy.
I guess this is what it means to worship someone.

It's a famous club at F.O.S. Some people even continue participating in club activities after graduation. Their activities seem to revolve around studying and researching 【kuroname】's school dossier with great reverence.
Hold on, now that I take a closer look... aren't you 【kuroname】?
I suggest you hide quickly. They're about to hold some kind of ceremony and plan to scatter flower petals all the way to the Golden Hall while looking for you.
Is that right? Bring it on!
